l.i: Non sic Supremi progenies patris Se vera culpis talibus inficit. Sed iura sacratosque nutus Æthereí tinet vsque regis. Væsana quò te plebs agitat furor? O, sic rependis munera cœlitus Accepta diuûm? Sic parentis Dona tui veneraris alma? Nonne ille gentis principium tuæ, Authorque solus nobilis extitit: Cunctisque secretam profestis Te populis sibi vindicauit? Percurre tempus præteritum memor Expende fastos: quæque prioribus Sæclis auorum vidit ætas: Quæque patres docuere nostri. Cernes vt alto qui sedet æthere, Quum regna certis limitibus dedit Diuisa: contentasque terris Quasque suis habitare plebes Iussit per orbem, fertile tunc solum Et lata charis rura nepotibus Seiunxit Abrami fidelis, Atque satis spatiosa cuncta Futura genti: quam sibi perpete Verax iugatam fœdere diligit: Vt qui paternos lictus hæres Sulcat agros atanûmque rura.

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "tinet" (line 4, probably "tenet") [?] and "Væsana" (line 5, probably "Vesana") [?] are marked in the text. "lictus" (line 27) is doubtful [?]. The word "profestis" (line 11) is read from long-s forms and may be "profestis" or similar. The word "Æthereí" in line 4 has a doubtful final letter. The ligatures for "æ", "æ" and "quæ" in the verse are read as "æ" and may be misread. The verse has no printed stanza breaks, so it is given as one paragraph.
